text:
maya: Following up on the INC-2026 followups — we need a compact playbook for the recurring KV-cache eviction spikes. Goal: one-page triage + exact commands + PD ladder. Keeping thread for owners/times.

sanjay: I can draft the triage checklist and the quick-commands section. Will add examples for 'inspect', 'drain-requests', and 'manual-evict'. Target: Thursday EOD.

rachel: I'll own escalation and PD entries. Proposal: oncall -> infra lead -> SRE pager after 20m if no recovery. Add a fast-rotate canary step (5m) before region fallback.

tom: Monitoring owner here. I'll create a composite alert: KV_EVICT_RATE and KV_HIT_RATIO drop; include recent-deploy tag in the alert so triage starts with deploy rollbacks. ETA tomorrow.

maya: Good. Important: include a decision rule for 'when to force-evict vs wait' and a safety abort path. We had two false positives last week.

sanjay: Draft snippet for runbook triage block (adding flags):```bash
# find eviction events in last 10m
rictl logs svc/inference --since 10m | jq 'select(.event=="kv_evict")'
# show hit ratio
redwood-metrics query 'kv_cache_hit_ratio{shard="inference"}' --last 5m
# dry-run eviction (safe)
rictl exec svc/inference --shard inference --force-kv-evict --dry-run
# commit eviction
rictl exec svc/inference --shard inference --force-kv-evict --confirm
```

rachel: Add a pre-check: if the eviction correlates with a single customer key (>80% of evictions), use token-bucket throttle instead of global evict. Include CS contact template.

tom: For alerts, I'll add a runbook link and the incident playbook URL in the alert payload. Also pushing a dashboard panel that visualizes per-customer eviction contribution.

ops-bot: [ops-bot] Playbook stub created: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/kv-evict-playbook (draft) - owners: sanjay (triage), rachel (escalation), tom (monitoring).

maya: Timeline recap: sanjay PR by Thu, rachel PD entries by Wed, tom alert + dashboard by Tue. I'll open a central GH issue to track subtasks and block on those dates.

sanjay: Quick question - should the playbook include the 'canary rotate' command sequence? I can add a short run of commands used to rotate canary instances.

rachel: Yes. Add sequence and a checklist: (1) start canary rotate, (2) watch 5m, (3) if recovery then continue, else escalate to region-fallback.

maya: Also add a short rollback snippet for recent model deploys (we saw deploy correlation). Keep it one-liner with link to rollback doc.

tom: Noted - I'll also flag any customers that consistently hit long-sequence flows and suggest a mitigation: proxy truncation or request-size limit until we ship better caching.

sanjay: PR created: https://git.redwood/ops/kv-evict-playbook/pull/7 - includes triage checklist + commands + short canary run. Marking WIP.

rachel: PD entries drafted and pushing to staging; will request review from security for notification text.

maya: Excellent. I'll follow up on Monday to confirm merged and deployed. If anyone needs reassignment speak up here. :+1:
